task: Sum the first 5 prime numbers (2, 3, 5, 7, 11) and store the result via (rlm-set answer ...) then (rlm-set Final true).
lesson: Today I learned `reduce` requires an explicit initial value as its first argument, not the accumulator variable.

Final t)))
